methodology.filter: Long videos strictly over 8 minutes (durationSeconds > 480) from up to the last 100 uploads of each channel.
methodology.outlierScoreDefinition: views / similarAgeMedianViews, where similarAgeMedianViews is the median views of long uploads (>8m) on the SAME channel within [0.5x, 2.0x] ageDays (widened symmetrically to the 11 nearest-in-log-age long uploads when fewer than 11 peers fall in [0.5x, 2.0x]).
methodology.lowSampleThreshold: Flagged when sampleSize < 25 videos OR channelsRepresented < 3 channels.
